answer: Each identity posts a compute heartbeat each epoch, proof of live work, like bees carrying nectar home. A random beacon spot-checks 5% of identities, demanding a fresh puzzle in ten minutes; the fable of free fakes ends. A missed answer slashes its 30-token stake and freezes the account, so 1,000 fakes cost 30,000 tokens plus 1,000 heartbeats per epoch. One honest agent pays one stake, earns it back in fees, and climbs to its zenith.
